title.narrative: 3.2 The Nigeria Immigration Service's institutional processes and operational guidelines reviewed and recommendations submitted, ensuring gender parity, inclusiveness and non-discrimination.

3.2.1 NIS processes conforms to new gender policy.
3.2.2 SOPs and main work documents updated for inclusiveness and non-discrimination.
3.2.3 Career progression framework gender mainstreamed.

target.value: CGI announces Gender Policy goes into effect, mainstreaming commenced

actual.value: The NIS Gender Policy was validated and adopted following the CGI's signature in October 2024, providing a foundational framework for institutional alignment. In line with this, key Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and work documents - particularly those related to recruitment, training, deployment, and career progression - were developed and updated to reflect principles of inclusiveness and non-discrimination Furthermore, the Career Progression and Training Framework (CPTF) was explicitly gender mainstreamed, ensuring that both male and female personnel have equitable access to training opportunities and career advancement.

target.value: CGI announces Gender Policy goes into effect, mainstreaming commenced

actual.value: Validation of the gender policy completed.

target.value: CGI announces Gender Policy goes into effect, mainstreaming commenced

actual.value: Validation of the gender policy is envisaged for 2023. However, the CGI has approved the establishment of female armed squad; and paternity leave for male officers in line with the new Federal Government directive.

title.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to support the institutional reform effort of the Nigerian Immigration Service to modernize its Human Resource Management System to increase internal efficiency, productivity and fairness among its workforce.

- Improved capacity of the Nigeria Immigration Service to modernize its human resource management system, linking performance to career advancement.
- Increased effectiveness of NIS to offer training opportunities to all staff through an e-learning platform for a more productive and efficient workforce.
- Greater representation of female officers and improved gender sensitive environment, providing a fairer work atmosphere for both men and women.
